targets.query:
(operator : $operator) and cost : *
| SELECT
    FLOOR(cost / 1000) * 1000 AS cost_level,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS percentage
GROUP BY cost_level
ORDER BY cost_level

panels.title: wallet-center

panels.description: 基于 LogStore (ext_request_log) 进行查询统计

targets.query:
api_method=cancelBet| SELECT 1, sum(is_success) AS success, sum(1 - is_success) AS fail FROM (
SELECT
"request_body.orderId",
CASE
WHEN bool_or(status_code = 200 AND "response_body.code" = 0) THEN 1
ELSE 0
END as is_success
FROM log
GROUP BY "request_body.orderId"
)

api_method=award
| SELECT 1,
sum(is_recovered) AS award_success,
sum(1 - is_recovered) AS award_fail
FROM (
SELECT
"request_body.orderId",
-- 如果该 ID 在所有记录中存在一条 200/0 的记录，则视为重试成功
MAX(CASE WHEN status_code = 200 AND "response_body.code" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_recovered
FROM log
WHERE "request_body.orderId" IN (
-- 【核心步】：先锁定所有发生过失败的订单 ID
SELECT "request_body.orderId"
FROM log
WHERE status_code != 200 OR "response_body.code" != 0
)
GROUP BY "request_body.orderId"
)
